description: Open-source screen recording and video editing tool for creating polished demos.
notes: Uses the official x64 NSIS installer as a 7-Zip archive, then extracts its nested app-64.7z payload like the referenced scoop-bucket manifest. The installer itself is not run.
The post-install hook removes installer leftovers and resources\app-update.yml so the app's installer-based updater does not bypass Scoop. Update with 'scoop update openscreen'.
OpenScreen also provides an ARM64 installer, but this manifest currently targets x64 only to match the referenced manifest's architecture scope.
The app stores user settings/cache outside the Scoop app directory; this manifest does not relocate that data to D:.
